jp: 教室[きょうしつ]{で|de-place}走[はし]る{な|na-prohibition}。
why: A plain dictionary-form verb plus な is a blunt "don't" command.

jp: 危[あぶ]ない、そこ{に/を|ni-target}触[さわ]る{な|na-prohibition}。
why: To forbid an action you attach な to the dictionary form of the verb.

jp: 夜[よる]遅[おそ]く{まで|made-until}遊[あそ]ぶ{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't play until late at night.
why: な after the dictionary form forbids the action; か would ask a question instead.

jp: そんなこと{で|de-cause}泣[な]く{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't cry over something like that.
why: Verb + な is the plain negative command, "don't cry".

jp: 私[わたし]{に|ni-recipient}嘘[うそ]{を|o-object}つく{な|na-prohibition}。
why: な ends a forbidding command built on the dictionary form of the verb.

jp: 約束[やくそく]{を|o-object}忘[わす]れる{な|na-prohibition}。
why: Forbidding someone to do something takes verb dictionary form + な.

jp: 明日[あした]{は|wa-topic}絶対[ぜったい]遅[おく]れる{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't be late tomorrow, whatever you do.
why: Even with 絶対 for emphasis, the prohibition itself is verb + な.

jp: このこと{は|wa-topic}母[はは]{に|ni-recipient}言[い]う{な|na-prohibition}。
why: な after 言う makes it a command not to say it.

jp: 授業中[じゅぎょうちゅう]{に|ni-time}寝[ね]る{な|na-prohibition}。
why: The dictionary form plus な forbids the action outright.

jp: 最後[さいご]{まで|made-until}あきらめる{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't give up until the end.
why: な is the sentence-final particle that turns あきらめる into "don't give up".

jp: 俺[おれ]{の|no-possessive}部屋[へや]{に/へ|ni-target}入[はい]る{な|na-prohibition}。
why: A blunt order not to enter uses the dictionary form of 入る plus な.

jp: 電車[でんしゃ]{の|no-possessive}中[なか]{で|de-place}電話[でんわ]{を|o-object}する{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't make phone calls on the train.
why: する plus な gives するな, "don't do it".

jp: 公園[こうえん]{で|de-place}ごみ{を|o-object}捨[す]てる{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't throw rubbish in the park.
why: A plain prohibition is the dictionary form of the verb followed by な.

jp: 人[ひと]{の|no-possessive}悪口[わるぐち]{を|o-object}言[い]う{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't speak ill of other people.
why: 言う + な forbids the speech act.

jp: 先生[せんせい]{は|wa-topic}「廊下[ろうか]{を|o-path}走[はし]る{な|na-prohibition}」{と|to-quote}注意[ちゅうい]しました。
en: The teacher warned, "Don't run in the corridor."
why: The quoted warning is a plain prohibition: verb dictionary form + な.

jp: 父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}「無理[むり]{を|o-object}する{な|na-prohibition}」{と|to-quote}言[い]いました。
why: するな is する plus the prohibitive な, "don't do it".

jp: 危[あぶ]ない。こっち{に/へ|ni-destination}来[く]る{な|na-prohibition}。
why: 来る plus な is the abrupt "don't come".

jp: 彼[かれ]{を|o-object}そんなに責[せ]める{な|na-prohibition}。
why: A command not to keep blaming him is verb dictionary form + な.

jp: 寝[ね]る前[まえ]{に|maeni-atode}食[た]べすぎる{な|na-prohibition}。
why: 食べすぎる + な forbids overeating.

jp: 動物[どうぶつ]{に|ni-recipient}えさ{を|o-object}やる{な|na-prohibition}。
why: やる plus な is a plain prohibition, as on a warning sign.

jp: 運転中[うんてんちゅう]{に|ni-time}スマホ{を|o-object}見[み]る{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't look at your phone while driving.
why: 見る + な is a firm prohibition.

jp: 失敗[しっぱい]{を|o-object}恐[おそ]れる{な|na-prohibition}。
why: A motto-like command: dictionary form 恐れる + な.

jp: 友達[ともだち]{と|to-reciprocal}けんかする{な|na-prohibition}。
why: けんかする + な forbids the action.

jp: 人[ひと]{に|ni-recipient}迷惑[めいわく]{を|o-object}かける{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't cause trouble for other people.
why: かける + な is the standard prohibitive form.

jp: 窓[まど]{から|kara-from}顔[かお]{を|o-object}出[だ]す{な|na-prohibition}。
en: Don't stick your head out of the window.
why: 出す + な forbids the action bluntly.

jp: あの人[ひと]{に|ni-target}近[ちか]づく{な|na-prohibition}。
why: 近づく + な is a command to stay away.
